verdict.rationale: Brex documents automatic receipt matching: uploaded receipts are matched to existing expenses (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-27). Its AI assistants are said to be "fetching receipts" for employees (brex-docs-23), and the review agent follows up with people who are out of compliance (brex-docs-16). Those last two claims are vague marketing, so the e-receipt and targeted-nudge parts of the story are only loosely implied. Missing for 10: named e-receipt integrations (e.g., email or vendor sources) that pull receipts automatically, documented missing-receipt nudges that fire only when a receipt is truly absent, and independent or hands-on confirmation of matching accuracy.
